sizes.hoses: 2 x 10 m, 1 in pressure / 1 1/4 in return, quick-disconnect

footprint.note: tow bar up; operator stands behind the panel (y about -1.4); hoses reach 10 m

reference: Wikimedia Commons: U.S. Air Force Hydraulic Test Stand inspection; 332nd EMS AGE Operations (public domain); 3000 psi ground cart sizes

parts.name: Frame
parts.move: root: the cart, rolls on its wheels

parts.name: Wheel_RL
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.205 m

parts.name: Wheel_RR
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.205 m

parts.name: FrontAxle
parts.move: steers about z +-35 deg (turntable), led by the tow bar

parts.name: Wheel_FL
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.205 m

parts.name: Wheel_FR
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.205 m

parts.name: TowBar
parts.move: hinge about x: 0 = up (parked) .. 80 deg forward = on the tug hitch; steers FrontAxle

parts.name: Gauge_System
parts.move: fixed: pump pressure 0..350 bar

parts.name: Needle_System
parts.move: turns about its local z (out of the dial) 0..270 deg clockwise from -135: pump pressure 0..350 bar

parts.name: Gauge_Delivery
parts.move: fixed: pressure to the aircraft 0..350 bar

parts.name: Needle_Delivery
parts.move: turns about its local z (out of the dial) 0..270 deg clockwise from -135: pressure to the aircraft 0..350 bar

parts.name: Gauge_Return
parts.move: fixed: return pressure 0..10 bar

parts.name: Needle_Return
parts.move: turns about its local z (out of the dial) 0..270 deg clockwise from -135: return pressure 0..10 bar

parts.name: Gauge_Flow
parts.move: fixed: flow 0..60 l/min

parts.name: Needle_Flow
parts.move: turns about its local z (out of the dial) 0..270 deg clockwise from -135: flow 0..60 l/min

parts.name: Gauge_Temperature
parts.move: fixed: fluid temperature

parts.name: Needle_Temperature
parts.move: turns about its local z (out of the dial) 0..270 deg clockwise from -135: fluid temperature

parts.name: Gauge_HourMeter
parts.move: fixed: pump hours

parts.name: Needle_HourMeter
parts.move: turns about its local z (out of the dial) 0..270 deg clockwise from -135: pump hours

parts.name: Valve_Pressure
parts.move: turns about the panel normal 0..3 turns: sets the delivery pressure (right = more)

parts.name: Valve_Bypass
parts.move: turns about the panel normal 0..270 deg (open): bypass open = no pressure to the aircraft

parts.name: Valve_Supply
parts.move: quarter turn about the panel normal 0..90 deg: opens the pressure line

parts.name: Valve_Return
parts.move: quarter turn about the panel normal 0..90 deg: opens the return line

parts.name: Button_Start
parts.move: pushes in 6 mm: starts the pump motor

parts.name: Button_Stop
parts.move: pushes in 6 mm: stops the pump motor

parts.name: EStop
parts.move: pushes in 8 mm and latches (emergency stop), twist to release: emergency stop

parts.name: Switch_Lamp
parts.move: flips about its local x -30..+30 deg: panel lamp on / off

parts.name: Coupling_Return
parts.move: quick-disconnect coupling: off its coil to the aircraft ground service port; sleeve slides back to couple

parts.name: Coupling_Pressure
parts.move: quick-disconnect coupling: off its coil to the aircraft ground service port; sleeve slides back to couple

parts.name: Door_Service
parts.move: hinge about z: 0 = shut .. 110 deg open (pump, motor, filters)

parts.name: ParkBrake
parts.move: lever about x: 0 = off (forward) .. 50 deg back = rear wheels braked

controls.does: lower onto the tug hitch / lift up to park; steer by hand to push
bypass open = no pressure to the aircraft
take the coupling to the aircraft port and couple it (sleeve back, push, release)
take the coupling to the aircraft port and couple it (sleeve back, push, release)
pull back = braked (before unhooking), forward = free to tow
